{{Top|leg}}
The '''Great Foam Incident''' occurred in [[Freighter Bay 4]] at the [[Estaria Central Starport]]. The bay's owner, [[Gol Inacc]], was unloading a shipment of expanding foam chemicals when a hauling accident caused them to break open. The foam quickly filled the bay, with the thick bubbly substance spreading into the main hall of the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport's]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] terminal. Once the foam combined with the [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], it produced noxious fumes, leading to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Biohazard|HazMat]] team being deployed to clean up. Inacc did not get paid for the shipment either.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
